name: Environment / ADMIN_API_KEY Guidance V1

environment_levels.host_base_url_pattern: Loopback-only SHRV1 and SHF-Next Vite hosts, typically http://127.0.0.1:5174 and http://127.0.0.1:5175.
environment_levels.admin_api_key_expectation: Optional for frontend-only work; required only when local smoke checks call admin-protected Agent Fabric endpoints.
environment_levels.route_bridge_expectation: May use default local bridge URLs or explicit VITE_SHRV1_BASE_URL and VITE_SHF_NEXT_BASE_URL values.
environment_levels.identity_bridge_expectation: Local-dev identity bridge metadata only; no production identity assumptions.
environment_levels.secret_handling: Use only placeholder or local-only keys in untracked env files.

environment_levels.host_base_url_pattern: Loopback-only local servers for SHRV1, SHF-Next, and Agent Fabric.
environment_levels.admin_api_key_expectation: Set ADMIN_API_KEY in the shell for smoke commands that require X-Admin-Key; never echo it into reports.
environment_levels.route_bridge_expectation: Use explicit local base URLs when both repos are running.
environment_levels.identity_bridge_expectation: Use internal/local route notices and local bridge classifications.
environment_levels.secret_handling: Keep key values in shell environment or ignored local env files.

environment_levels.host_base_url_pattern: HTTPS staging domains or owner-approved internal staging URLs.
environment_levels.admin_api_key_expectation: Required for admin-protected backend calls and stored only in the staging secret manager.
environment_levels.route_bridge_expectation: Must set VITE_SHRV1_BASE_URL and VITE_SHF_NEXT_BASE_URL to staging-safe HTTPS origins.
environment_levels.identity_bridge_expectation: Must identify staging as non-production and keep internal surfaces gated/noticed.
environment_levels.secret_handling: Secrets are injected by hosting/runtime configuration, not committed to the repo.

environment_levels.admin_api_key_expectation: Required, high-entropy, owner-controlled, rotated, and stored in production secret management.
environment_levels.route_bridge_expectation: Must use explicit production base URLs; no localhost defaults in production deployment config.
environment_levels.identity_bridge_expectation: Must use production identity/session rules before paid or public launch.
environment_levels.secret_handling: No secret appears in client bundles, logs, docs, commits, screenshots, or reports.

environment_levels.host_base_url_pattern: Demo-approved local, staging, or controlled public demo URL.
environment_levels.admin_api_key_expectation: Use a demo/staging key only when an operator runs protected admin actions; never expose keys to demo viewers.
environment_levels.route_bridge_expectation: Public demo routes must stay public-safe; internal routes require controlled operator access.
environment_levels.identity_bridge_expectation: Demo identity must be clearly marked as demo/internal and must not imply production auth.
environment_levels.secret_handling: No real keys in decks, screen recordings, reports, or screenshots.
must_not_commit: private client data exported for demos

admin_api_key_rules: ADMIN_API_KEY is server-side configuration for admin-protected Agent Fabric operations.
ADMIN_API_KEY must never be embedded in Vite client code, route URLs, query strings, docs, screenshots, or committed files.
Admin smoke commands may send the key as X-Admin-Key only from local shell or managed runtime secrets.
If ADMIN_API_KEY is missing on protected backend endpoints, the backend should fail closed rather than silently allow access.
Local examples may use placeholder text only.
Staging and production keys must be high-entropy, owner-controlled, environment-specific, and rotated after suspected exposure.
The same key must not be shared across local, staging, demo, and production environments.

cross_app_env_vars.name: VITE_SHRV1_BASE_URL
cross_app_env_vars.purpose: Base URL used by SHRV1/SHF-Next route bridge links back to SHRV1 admin surfaces.

cross_app_env_vars.name: VITE_SHF_NEXT_BASE_URL
cross_app_env_vars.purpose: Base URL used by cross-app links into SHF-Next public and internal surfaces.

cross_app_env_vars.name: SHF_WEB_ORIGIN
cross_app_env_vars.purpose: Optional backend CORS origin value for local or deployed web origin configuration.

env_file_policy.gitignore_status: .env and .env.* are ignored; .env.example is allowed for placeholder documentation.

secret_scanning_checklist: Review git diff for .env.example and docs that mention environment variables.
Search for ADMIN_API_KEY assignments outside .env.example and ignored local env files.
Search staged changes for bearer tokens, API keys, private keys, passwords, and authorization headers.
Confirm no runtime logs, local JSON persistence, dist output, node_modules, or cache files are staged.
Confirm screenshots, PDFs, and demo exports do not show secrets.
production_readiness_requirements: Production ADMIN_API_KEY is configured in a secret manager, not in the repository.
Production SHRV1 and SHF-Next base URLs are HTTPS and explicit.
Admin-protected endpoints are smoke-tested with missing, invalid, and valid admin key cases.
Public routes never require or display admin key metadata.
Internal routes remain private, gated, or clearly internal-noticed.
CORS origins are explicit for production domains.
Key rotation and suspected leak procedures are documented and rehearsed.
Production persistence, auth/session, and paid-launch gates are complete before paid launch.
local_setup_checklist: Copy .env.example to an ignored local env file such as .env.local.
Replace ADMIN_API_KEY placeholder locally only if admin smoke checks are needed.
Start SHRV1 on the configured VITE_SHRV1_BASE_URL.
Start SHF-Next on the configured VITE_SHF_NEXT_BASE_URL if cross-app links are being tested.
Run npm run check:governance and npm run build before release packaging.
staging_setup_checklist: Configure ADMIN_API_KEY in staging secret management.
Configure VITE_SHRV1_BASE_URL and VITE_SHF_NEXT_BASE_URL to staging HTTPS origins.
Configure backend allowed web origin for the staging frontend.
Run governance, build, route bridge, identity bridge, and admin endpoint smoke checks.
Confirm no staging secrets appear in logs or build artifacts.
production_setup_checklist: Create a production-only ADMIN_API_KEY in secret management.
Configure production HTTPS base URLs explicitly.
Confirm public/private route classification before launch.
Run final secret scan, governance checks, build, and protected endpoint smoke tests.
Record owner approval for paid/public launch.
key_rotation_checklist: Update the secret manager for the target environment.
Restart or redeploy services that read ADMIN_API_KEY.
Run missing, invalid, and valid key smoke checks.
Record the rotation date, owner, and reason outside public docs.
suspected_leak_checklist: Treat the key as compromised immediately.
Rotate the key before continuing normal operations.
Search git history, current diffs, logs, screenshots, and exported artifacts for the leaked value.
Audit admin endpoint access around the exposure window.
Document the incident and prevention step without recording the secret value.

remaining_risks: This guidance does not implement production auth/session hardening.
Operator discipline is still required to keep real secrets out of screenshots, logs, and local reports.
Production readiness still depends on external secret management and deployment configuration.
